meta.title: Sonoria - Advanced Audio Analysis Library
meta.description: High-performance C++ library for audio feature extraction, music information retrieval, and sound analysis. Open-source alternative to Essentia with modern CMake support.
meta.keywords: audio analysis, music information retrieval, MIR, feature extraction, C++ audio library, Sonoria, open source audio, FFT, spectral analysis

hero.title: Powerful Audio Analysis for Modern Applications
hero.subtitle: Extract meaningful insights from audio data with Sonoria's high-performance algorithms

items.title: High Performance
items.desc: Optimized C++ implementation with SIMD support and multi-threading capabilities

items.title: Modern Build System
items.desc: Native CMake support with vcpkg, Conan, and system package manager integration

items.title: Cross-Platform
items.desc: Runs seamlessly on Linux, macOS, and Windows with consistent API

items.title: Rich Feature Set
items.desc: 200+ audio descriptors including spectral, temporal, and tonal features

install.title: Quick Installation
install.source_cmd:
git clone https://github.com/yourorg/sonoria.git
cd sonoria && mkdir build && cd build
cmake .. && make && sudo make install

steps.title: Include the Library
steps.desc: Start by including the necessary Sonoria headers in your C++ project.

steps.title: Initialize an Algorithm
steps.desc: Create and configure audio analysis algorithms with your specific parameters.

steps.title: Process Audio Data
steps.desc: Feed audio frames to the algorithm and retrieve computed features.
